description: This is a JavaScript source file that contains functions and type definitions related to parsing, comparing, and managing release versions, particularly for NPM packages. It defines regex patterns for version formats, parsing functions, comparison logic, and authentication helpers for npm publish plans.

methods.name: parseDateParts
methods.description: Parses date components from version groups, validates them, and constructs a ParsedReleaseVersion object.

methods.name: parseReleaseVersion
methods.description: Parses a version string into a ParsedReleaseVersion object, recognizing stable, beta, and correction versions.

methods.name: compareReleaseVersions
methods.description: Compares two version strings based on parsed release data, returning a sign indicator or null if invalid.

methods.name: resolveNpmPublishPlan
methods.description: Determines the publish plan (channel, tags) for a given version, considering an optional current beta version.

methods.name: resolveNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Resolves and returns authentication info based on provided npm tokens.

methods.name: shouldRequireNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Determines if npm dist tag mirror authentication is required based on mode, tags, and auth presence.
